items.title: Europe targeted by spiralling campaign of sabotage - and Russia is the chief suspect
items.description: Germany has blamed Russia for an attack on Leipzig airport but there has been a series of suspicious incidents elsewhere.

items.title: 'Layer upon layer of miracles': How Nepal flood survivors were rescued from tunnel
items.description: From searching for a buried tunnel entrance to blowing up rocks the size of cars, rescuers had to surmount multiple challenges to reach survivors.

items.title: UK support for Falkland Islands 'unwavering' after Argentina restates claims, No 10 says
items.description: The comments come as Argentinian president Javier Milei says the "winds of change" favoured his country's claim on the British overseas territory.

items.title: US diesel prices hit an all-time-high
items.description: Fuel prices have soared since the Iran conflict began at the end of February, mirroring the surge in wholesale oil prices.

items.title: Steve Irwin's family celebrates 'superhero' dad, 20 years after shock death
items.description: The Australian icon was killed in 2006, after a stingray's barb pierced his chest during filming.

items.title: Body of world's youngest traditional king returns home to Uganda amid succession row
items.description: King Oyo died in the US last week aged 34 after receiving treatment for an aggressive form of cancer.

items.title: 100 influencers invited to US Open spark debate on 'tennis etiquette'
items.description: The behaviour of influencers and content creators has become a major talking point at this year's US Open amid incidents of matches being disrupted.
